snip.t: | Brain abscess | Focal signs early, source in ear/sinus, fever | Ring-enhancing mass on CT, LP contraindicated |
Neurological: *Neck stiffness, photophobia, focal deficits, altered consciousness?* — Meningeal signs → meningitis; focal deficits → brain abscess or cerebral malaria.
Other: Rupture into the pleura, lung (empyema, hepatobronchial fistula), pericardium (rare, dangerous) or peritoneum; amoebic brain abscess (rare); skin (perianal)

qs.q: A patient presents with a brain abscess containing darkly pigmented septate hyphae. Which organism is most likely responsible?
qs.e: Phaeohyphomycosis, which can present as a brain abscess with pigmented hyphae, is caused by Cladophialophora species. Madurella causes mycetoma, and Sporothrix causes lymphangitic spread.
qs.s: Medical Mycology Fundamentals: Fungi, Antifungal Drugs & More: MCQs

qs.q: A patient presents with a brain abscess, and pathology reveals darkly pigmented septate hyphae. Which genus is the most likely causative agent?
qs.e: Phaeohyphomycosis presenting as a brain abscess with darkly pigmented septate hyphae is typically caused by Cladophialophora species. Histoplasma capsulatum typically presents as yeast within macrophages rather than pigmented hyphae.
qs.s: Medical Mycology Fundamentals: Fungi, Antifungal Drugs & More: MCQs

qs.q: Your patient has a brain abscess detected 1 month after a dental extraction. Which organism is most likely involved?
qs.e: Dental procedures introduce oral anaerobic flora into the bloodstream; anaerobic streptococci are a classic cause of brain abscess following dental extraction.
qs.s: Medical Bacteriology MCQs: Review Strep, TB, Anthrax & More

qs.q: A 64-year-old 90-pack-year smoker has had productive cough with copious mucoid sputum for more than 3 months per year for 5 years. He dies of septicemia and brain abscess. Autopsy shows mucus gland hypertrophy. Most likely diagnosis?
qs.e: Chronic bronchitis is defined as productive cough for at least 3 months in at least 2 consecutive years. Mucus gland hypertrophy is the pathologic hallmark. Smoking and air pollution are the key causes.

qs.q: 54-year-old man, worsening headache, right arm weakness, brain abscess with darkly pigmented septate hyphae = phaeohyphomycosis. Genus? Cladophialophora bantiana is a classic neurotropic dematiaceous (pigmented) mold causing cerebral phaeohyphomycosis. ---
qs.e: Cladophialophora bantiana is a dematiaceous mold with a strong predilection for causing cerebral abscesses.
